description: Lists the authenticated user's prospects (people with a generated message) with their pipeline status, optionally filtered by campaign or status, and each one's owner ("Responsável": the workspace member who sends the person's WhatsApp tasks, null for nobody). Returns a compact summary, without the full message and history.

limit.description: Max prospects to return (default and max 50).

status.description: Only prospects in this pipeline status.

name: list_prospects
title: Listar prospecções
